error.message: location[2] is driven (an action drives it): the program recomputes it when it opens the file, so a value written there wouldn't hold
error.next: An action, an NLA strip or a driver animates the channel (a component of the transform, or a visibility bit), or a constraint acts on the transform, so the program recomputes it when it opens the file and a value written here wouldn't hold. Nothing was applied. Change what drives it in the app. A file verb still writes a channel nothing drives and a bit it keeps as stored (`details.channel` names the one refused: `location[2]`, `hide_viewport`), and a transform under constraints (with the warning `blend_constrained`). Live, a driven transform refuses the whole placement, and any animated visibility bit the whole `object visibility` (`details.channel` names the bits: `hide_viewport,hide_render`). Its name is still written.

next_step.why: Read the object's fields: `edit` is `a` when its transform is driven; `visanim` names its animated visibility bits.
